title: kate-ui: offer recovery at launch and stash unsaved text on quit
summary: At launch the window turns the journal on, reads the pending journals, replays each one whose file still has the recorded digest, and asks Recover or Discard per file. Discard clears the journal; Recover opens the file and replaces its text in one undoable step. Untitled modified documents are stashed at quit and reopened at launch.

lane.reason: A Cursor local agent on the owner Mac codes this packet. session.rs imports GPUI, the crate builds only on macOS, and the owner looks at the window after the change.

definitions.definition:
/// Offers for the journals whose file still has the digest in the journal name. Others are cleared.
fn recovery_offers(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Vec<RecoveryOffer>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: launch calls workspace.set_recovery_dir(Some(recovery_dir(home))) when HOME is set. recovery_offers reads each pending journal, loads the file at the header path with kate_fileio::load through kate-core or std::fs and sha2 is not available in kate-ui, so compare the journal file name with the digest that a fresh Workspace::open reports in file.digest_on_disk; a mismatch or a missing file clears the journal. A sheet per offer shows Recover unsaved changes to <name>? with Recover and Discard. Recover opens the path, runs SelectAll then InsertText(text) so one Undo returns to the disk text, and keeps the journal until the next save. At quit each untitled modified document is written with write_stash in tab order and the stash is read, opened as untitled documents, and cleared at launch. The test recovery_offers_skip_a_changed_file writes a temp file, starts a journal for it under a temp recovery dir with one insert line, asserts one offer with the replayed text, then changes the file bytes, and asserts no offer and no journal file. The owner kills the app after typing and relaunches. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::recovery_offers_skip_a_changed_file
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because recovery_offers does not exist. After the change a matching journal gives one offer and a changed file clears its journal.
